title: THE OLYMPIC DEBUT
excerpt: Vladislav Ursu’s debut at the Olympic Games
body_html:
Moldova’s Olympic debut in table tennis.

To the regret of Moldova’s table tennis fans, the first Olympic win in men’s singles table tennis at Paris 2024 went to Kanak Jha of the USA. Vladislav Ursu lost to the American 0–4, but every spectator in the stands applauded Vlad for his remarkable achievements and for making history as the first table tennis player from the Republic of Moldova to compete at the Olympic Games.

Jha won the match 11-5, 11-6, 11-5 and 11-3 — but remember, Kanak Jha is no newcomer to the Olympic stage and has been one of the best table tennis players in North America over the past decade.

Even so, Jha had to draw on all his experience and skill to come out on top, as Vlad was determined and, especially in the first games, put up visible resistance to his opponent’s attacks.

We give our full support to our athlete Vladislav Ursu and thank him sincerely for the historic moments and the pride he has given each of us!

P.S. “Whoever wins is happy; whoever loses grows wiser.”
